thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] P1 pager triggered for prod-gpu-eu: pool queue length > 1500 (3m). autoscaler attempts failing. runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/gpu-capacity

olivia_oncall: I'm on pager, joining. seeing massive 95th p50 token latency increase in console.

matt_sre: dashboard -> https://grafana/prod-gpu-eu shows queue growth starting ~12:02 UTC. autoscaler logs: repeated 'scale rejected: quota exceeded' around same time.

jia_runtime: checking driver logs on suspicious nodes, getting repeating CUDA Xid 13 and OOM entries. suspect a driver/kernel regression interacting with long-lived KV cache. grabbing /var/log/messages now.

sam_infra: nodes flapping: i-0a1b2c3d4e, i-0f9e8d7c6b, i-0123456789. kernel: "NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 13" repeated every ~30s.

rachel_support: FYI customer support queue spiking. Customer-42, Acme Search, reporting timeouts and 502s. opening incident template for external comms.

olivia_oncall: immediate mitigation plan: 1) rate-limit / throttle non-critical requests (embeddings batch jobs) 2) enable fallback model routing to cpu-embed pool for embeddings 3) remove problematic nodes from rotation and roll driver restart 4) request emergency capacity from Dedicated pool if possible.

ben_prodops: can we trigger dedicated-burst? I can flip fallback routing to dedicated-dc for customer-tiered traffic. prepping command.

matt_sre: autoscaler note: it tried to add nodes but cloud provider returned 'INSUFFICIENT_QUOTA' which is why scale was rejected. we still have some spare dedicated reserved capacity but it's on different account/region.

jia_runtime: while we coordinate infra, we should enable graceful queue shedding to prevent tail latency explosions. propose returning 429 for large batched requests over 16k tokens and queue depth > 100.

olivia_oncall: executing short-term throttles now.

olivia_oncall: applied API rate-limit: 60r/s for embeddings.non-critical clients. observed inbound drop ~30%.

deploy-bot: deploy started: toggle-route fallback -> dedicated-burst (deploy id: dpl-9923).

ben_prodops: fallback enabled for routes: embeddings.read-only.*, embeddings.batch.*. routing logs show ~600 rps shifted to dedicated-burst.

sam_infra: cordoning problematic nodes and draining pods. command:

```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-65
kubectl drain gpu-node-65 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
ssh ec2-user@gpu-node-65 'sudo systemctl restart nvidia-drm && sudo systemctl restart nvidia-persistenced'
```

matt_sre: note: restart might clear Xid but we could see short-term allocation failures. doing one node at a time.

jia_runtime: collecting driver stack traces and nv-hostengine logs. saving to /tmp/incident-3923456789 for postmortem. key stack snippet:

```
NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 13, pid=12345, Watchdog: hang
kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 12345 (runner) total-vm:1024000kB
```

olivia_oncall: rolling restart in progress. swapped 4 nodes so far. queue length dropped from 1700 -> 480 in 9 minutes. good signal.

rachel_support: starting customer comms draft: "We are experiencing elevated errors and latency for requests in EU. We have throttled large batch jobs and shifted traffic to dedicated capacity. Working on restoring normal service. Will update in 30m." please review.

ben_prodops: dedicated-burst currently covering ~40% of peak demand after routing. still need more if queue persists.

matt_sre: autoscaler still unable to scale because cloud quota checks still failing. raising support ticket with cloud provider now (case #CP-99817).

sam_infra: observed one node re-entered Ready then flapped again after 2m. marking that node as suspect and isolating to forensic pool.

jia_runtime: hypothesis: recent driver package v515.48 was rolled to subset of nodes in last deploy window. Correlates with first Xid occurrence at 11:59. Retracing rollout history.

olivia_oncall: handoff incoming in 20m — I need to restate current state for next oncall: 1) throttles in place 2) fallback routing active 3) 6 nodes drained/rolled, queue reduced to ~420 4) cloud quota ticket open 5) some nodes still suspect and isolated.

ben_prodops: I can take over. I'll continue dedicated routing and cloud escalation. @jia_runtime please keep investigating driver correlation.

olivia_oncall: handing off to ben_prodops. I'm OOO for the next 45m but will be reachable for urgent questions. handoff summary pinned above. :white_check_mark:

ben_prodops: taking over. creating checklist in incident doc, will update every 15m.

deploy-bot: deploy completed: rollback driver v515.48 -> v515.36 on pool-prod-gpu-eu (rollout id rlt-3301).

jia_runtime: rolling back driver version on remaining suspect hosts, watching for Xid recurrence.

matt_sre: metrics: tail latency p95 back to baseline ~12:42 UTC, error rate down from 4.2% -> 0.9%. still tracking queue depth and requeue spikes.

rachel_support: sent first customer update at 12:20 UTC, follow-up scheduled at 12:50. collecting impacted customer list from logs: approx 18 tenants saw >25% error rate in the window.

ben_prodops: next steps: 1) confirm cloud provider quota resolution 2) complete driver rollback on all affected nodes 3) run soak tests for 1h with gradual traffic ramp 4) postmortem and customer impact report.

jia_runtime: collected logs and kernel dumps uploaded to s3://incidents/3923456789/ for analysis.

olivia_oncall: thanks team. please tag me if anything regresses during my time away.

ben_prodops: incident status -> monitoring state. keeping this thread open for updates. :eyes:\"
